consumer: The frontend HP-bar renderer asking 'which color (green/yellow/red) does the GUI paint this monster's HP bar?' — i.e. the engine's own HP-to-color mapping, not the raw fraction.
scope: The per-monster display color bucket the GUI assigns from its own HP thresholds/rounding, matching the engine's coloring function exactly (not a re-derived current/max ratio).
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities (monsters) — emits raw mon.get_hp()/get_hp_max() integers straight from the engine getters, exposing simulation state but never invoking the GUI's HP-to-color logic.
divergence: A monster sitting on a color-bucket boundary (e.g. HP just above the green/yellow cutoff) where the GUI's own thresholding/rounding paints yellow while a naive get_hp()/get_hp_max() ratio computed by the consumer reads green — the two disagree on color.
